paragraphs.en: vLLM is a fast and easy-to-use library for LLM inference and serving.
paragraphs.zh: vLLM 是一个快速且易于使用的大语言模型（LLM）推理与服务库。

paragraphs.en: Originally developed in the Sky Computing Lab at UC Berkeley, vLLM has grown into one of the most active open-source AI projects built and maintained by a diverse community of many dozens of academic institutions and companies from over 2000 contributors.
paragraphs.zh: vLLM 最初由加州大学伯克利分校的天空计算实验室开发，现已成长为最活跃的开源 AI 项目之一，由来自众多学术机构和公司的多元化社区构建和维护，拥有来自 2000 多名贡献者的支持。

paragraphs.en: vLLM seamlessly supports 200+ model architectures on Hugging Face, including:
paragraphs.zh: vLLM 无缝支持 Hugging Face 上 200 多种模型架构，包括：

paragraphs.en: Find the full list of supported models here .
paragraphs.zh: 在此处查看受支持模型的完整列表。

paragraphs.en: Install vLLM with uv (recommended) or pip :
paragraphs.zh: 使用 uv（推荐）或 pip 安装 vLLM：

paragraphs.en: uv pip install vllm vllm download-kernels # precompiled kernels for faster startup Or build from source for development.
paragraphs.zh:
uv pip install vllm vllm download-kernels # 预编译内核，加快启动速度
或者，如果用于开发，可以从源代码构建。
